Name: Massive Greenhouse 50x50
Author: Littleking92
Description:
[b][u]FEATURES[/u][/b]
Massive Greenhouse
50x50 area to plant crops
Supports 55 fruit trees
Small storage room for AutoGrabber and Automate mods (If you wish to use those mods, not required )



[b][u]REQUIREMENTS[/u][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿﻿[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿


[u][b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b][/u]
1. Download the Mod
2. Unzip into the "Mods" folder
3.Make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher﻿ installed.
